newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria, Yemen sign nine cooperation agreements.
newsitem.headline: Syria, Yemen sign nine cooperation agreements.

text.p: DAMASCUS, Oct 9 (Reuter ) - Syria and Yemen signed nine deals on Wednesday to boost economic, industrial, tourism, trade, cultural and information cooperation between the two countries, official sources said.
They said Syrian Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi and Yemeni counterpart Abdul-Aziz Abdul-Ghani attended the signing at the end of the third session of the higher Syrian-Yemeni committee.
The other agreements and draft deals for cooperation were for investment, transport, agriculture, health and sports.
Official sources also said trade exchange between Syria and Yemen was worth 100 million Syrian pounds ($2 million) in 1995.
